text: Having some direction is definitely helpful, because it gives you a reason to make an effort when things get boring or difficult. But I don't think goals need to be fixed at eighteen. Many people only discover what they're good at in their twenties, after trying a few different things. So I'd say a general sense of direction matters more than a detailed ten-year plan.

tips.en: The value of goals, with a caveat: not necessarily at eighteen.
tips.kk: Мақсаттың пайдасы және ескерту: он сегізде міндетті емес.
tips.ru: Польза целей и оговорка: не обязательно в восемнадцать.
tips.example: But I don't think goals need to be fixed at eighteen

tips.en: Matters more than gives a clear conclusion.
tips.example: a general sense of direction matters more than a detailed ten-year plan

note.en: “A rough idea of where you are going”.

questions.question: Is it important for young people to have clear goals?

text: Often it's because the goal was unrealistic from the start, or it was too vague, like 'get fit' or 'learn English'. When there's no clear first step, it's easy to keep postponing it. Another reason is that people expect quick results, and when progress is slow, they assume they've failed. In reality, most achievements come from small, boring actions repeated for months.

tips.en: Get fit and learn English show what a vague goal looks like.
tips.kk: Get fit, learn English — «бұлыңғыр мақсат» не екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Get fit, learn English — показывает, что значит «размытая цель».

tips.en: In reality moves from expectations to the truth.
tips.ru: In reality — переход от ожиданий к правде.
tips.example: In reality, most achievements come from small, boring actions

questions.question: Why do some people give up on their goals?

text: Very much so. When people are young, their goals tend to be about achievement — a good degree, an impressive job, maybe travelling the world. Later on, priorities often shift towards stability and relationships, like buying a home or spending more time with family. And in older age, I think many people care most about health and about passing something on to their grandchildren.

tips.en: Youth, middle age and old age — the answer follows a timeline.
tips.kk: Жастық, есейген шақ, қарттық — жауап уақыт бойынша құрылған.
tips.ru: Молодость, зрелость, старость — ответ построен по времени.
tips.example: When people are young, their goals tend to be about achievement

tips.en: Priorities shift towards is more precise than just change.
tips.kk: Priorities shift towards — жай change сөзінен дәлірек.
tips.ru: Priorities shift towards — точнее, чем просто change.
tips.example: priorities often shift towards stability and relationships

questions.question: Do you think people's goals change as they get older?

text: Parents can certainly help by sharing their experience and pointing out options a teenager might not know about. The problem starts when they choose for the child — for instance, insisting on medicine because it's prestigious, even when the child obviously loves design. People rarely succeed at something they were pushed into. So I think parents should act more like advisers than decision-makers.

tips.en: The problem starts when shows exactly where help turns into pressure.
tips.kk: The problem starts when — көмектің қай жерде қысымға айналатынын дәл көрсетеді.
tips.ru: The problem starts when — точно показывает, где помощь становится давлением.
tips.example: The problem starts when they choose for the child

tips.en: More like advisers than decision-makers is a compact conclusion.
tips.kk: More like advisers than decision-makers — сыйымды қорытынды.
tips.ru: More like advisers than decision-makers — ёмкий итог.
tips.example: act more like advisers than decision-makers

questions.question: Should parents help their children choose their goals?

text: I think the best approach is actually a combination: one big goal that gives your life a direction, broken down into several small ones that you can achieve in a few weeks. The big goal keeps you motivated, while the small ones give you regular proof that you're making progress. Without that, a big goal can feel so far away that it becomes discouraging.

tips.en: Not either-or but a combination — a thoughtful answer.
tips.example: the best approach is actually a combination

tips.en: While shows the different roles of big and small goals.
tips.kk: While үлкен және кіші мақсаттардың әртүрлі рөлін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: While показывает разную роль большой и малых целей.
tips.example: while the small ones give you regular proof that you're making progress

questions.question: Is it better to have one big goal or several small ones?
